title: Checkout: payment step
intro:
We're simplifying the payment step of checkout. Each option below is a clickable prototype; try paying for the order as you normally would.

These are rough prototypes, so not every button works.
questions: Which option makes it clearest what you'll be charged?
Is anything confusing or missing when you choose how to pay?
Which one would you trust most with your card details?

items.label: Option A
items.note: Single page, summary on the right
